Students must have gained admission into the Single Subject Credential Program prior to registering for any of the core courses. All prerequisites must be completed before program admission . Under SB 2042 regulations, the Single Subject Credential authorizes individuals to teach in English Learner settings. Candidates wishing to concurrently earn the Bilingual Authorization must consult the coordinator of the Bilingual Program for admission to the program and develop a program plan. Information on the bilingual authorization can be found at https://www.cpp.edu/ceis/credential-program/bilingual-authorizations.shtml . https://www.cpp.edu/ceis/credential-program/preliminary-single-subject-credential.shtml Single Subject Credential program coursework includes: Credential Required: 36 units EDU 5010 - Foundations of Teaching and Learning (3) EDU 5020 - Foundations of Education in a Diverse Society (3) EDU 5200 - Secondary Reading and Writing in the Content Areas (3) EDU 5205 - Secondary Curriculum and Methods (3) EDU 5210 - Teaching Secondary English Learners (3) EDU 5215 - Models of Secondary Instruction (3) EDU 5220 - Building Relationships with Youth, Families, and Communities (3) EDU 5260 - Single Subject Clinical Practice (1-8) (8 units required) EDU 5262 - Clinical Practice Seminar for Single Subject Candidates (1) EDU 5280 - Teaching Performance Assessment for Secondary Teachers (3) EDU 5302 - Ed

courses.title: Foundations of Teaching and Learning
courses.description: Examines foundational learning, human development, and motivation theories and their applications, classroom management, and assessment. Opportunities for applied professional decision-making, planning, and reflection related to teaching and learning in a variety of contexts including TK-12. Includes 10 hours of field experience.
courses.prerequisites: ECS ITEP subplan/option, LS ITEP subplan/option, junior standing, senior standing, or admitted into Multiple Subject, Single Subject, or Education Specialist Credential.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Foundations of Education in a Diverse Society
courses.description: Examines foundations of schooling in the US with a focus on theoretical and historical approaches toward educational equity for diverse communities. Supports teacher candidates in developing culturally responsive teacher dispositions. Introduces sociolinguistic principles of effective pedagogies for English learners. May include up to 10 hours of field experience.
courses.prerequisites: ECS ITEP subplan/option, LS ITEP subplan/option, junior standing, senior standing, or admitted into Multiple Subject, Single Subject, or Education Specialist Credential.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Secondary Reading and Writing in the Content Areas
courses.description: For secondary level teachers from all content areas. Examination of the roles that reading and writing play in learning. Examine the cognitive and socio-cultural characteristics shared by the reading and writing processes. The course includes 20 hours of fieldwork related to course content.
courses.prerequisites: Junior standing, senior standing, or admitted into Single Subject Credential.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Secondary Curriculum and Methods
courses.description: Principles and methodology of teaching in a content area in the secondary schools including instructional design, material selection, student assessment, and the development of state-adopted academic content standard based lesson plans. May include 10 hours of fieldwork.
courses.prerequisites: Admitted into Single Subject Credential; EDU 5010 or TED 406; and EDU 5020 , or TED 405 and TED 407.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Teaching Secondary English Learners
courses.description: Application of principles and strategies for design of effective learning for secondary English learners. Development of interactive lessons to build students’ disciplinary literacies in content areas. Use of teaching standards and other resources to differentiate instruction and evaluate student progress.
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Single Subject Credential; EDU 5010 or TED 406; EDU 5020 , or TED 406 and TED 407; and EDU 5200 or TED 432. Pre or Corequisite(s): EDU 5302 or EDS 403.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Models of Secondary Instruction
courses.description: Course explores principles and methods of models of instruction for secondary classrooms that promote project- and inquiry-based learning, among others. The promotion of healthy living throughout the curriculum is also explored. Fieldwork: Includes up to 20 hours of fieldwork. 3 seminars.
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Single Subject Credential; EDU 5010 or TED 406; EDU 5020 , or TED 405 and TED 407; and EDU 5200 or TED 432. Pre or Corequisite(s): EDU 5302 or EDS 403.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Building Relationships with Youth, Families, and Communities
courses.description: Examines historical and contemporary approaches toward working with diverse youth, families, and communities. Analyzes principles for building respectful, reciprocal relations with youth and caregivers. Builds strategies for managing caring, productive classrooms, teaching about healthy lifestyles, and supporting youth experiencing crises. May include up to 20 hours of fieldwork. This is a required course for Cal Poly Pomona’s Single Subject credential program.
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Single Subject Credential; and EDU 5020 , or TED 405 and TED 407.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Single Subject Clinical Practice
courses.description: Supervised full day teaching in university-approved classroom. The prospective teacher will experience teaching responsibilities in culturally diverse public school settings. Corequisite(s): EDU 5280 .
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Single Subject Credential, EDU 5205 or TED 434, EDU 5210 or TED 442, EDU 5215 or TED 446, and EDU 5200 or TED 432.

courses.title: Clinical Practice Seminar for Single Subject Candidates
courses.description: Seminar to support supervised teaching in university-approved culturally diverse public-school settings. Single subject candidates connect theory to practice as they plan, teach, and assess, and apply what they learn to promote learning environments based on equity, professional responsibilities, and Teacher Performance Expectations.
courses.prerequisites: Admission to Single Subject Credential Program, successful completion of Key Assessments, and approved application to Clinical Practice by required deadline.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 3 units, with a maximum of 1 unit per semester.

courses.title: Teaching Performance Assessment for Secondary Teachers
courses.description: Single subject candidates connect theory to practice as they apply and reflect on their teaching practice and professional behaviors based on classroom equity, professional responsibilities, and Teacher Performance Expectations. Candidates complete the Teaching Performance Assessment and develop a plan for continuing their growth on the California Standards for the Teaching Profession. Corequisite(s): EDU 5260 or EDU 5420 .
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Single Subject Credential, EDU 5205 or TED 434, EDU 5210 or TED 442, EDU 5215 or TED 446, and EDU 5220 .

courses.title: Educating Students with Disabilities in Diverse Settings
courses.description: Students will learn characteristics of K-12 students with disabilities, students who are at risk, and students who are gifted with a focus on access, equity, and effective assessment and instruction. Includes federal and state IEP and legislative requirements. Includes field experience across a variety of special education settings.
courses.prerequisites: Junior standing, ECS ITEP subplan/option, LS ITEP subplan/option, admitted to Multiple Subject Credential, admitted to Education Specialist Credential, or admitted to Single Subject Credential.
